import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int v, f, c, next;
        Edge(int v, int f, int c, int next) {
            this.v = v;
            this.f = f;
            this.c = c;
            this.next = next;
        }
    }

    static final int MAX_D = 11;
    static final int MAX_N = 1000;
    static final int MAX_E = 100100;
    static final int MAX_FLOW_VAL = 1 << 29;

    static Edge[] E = new Edge[2 * MAX_E];
    static int[] head = new int[MAX_N];
    static int[] ptr = new int[MAX_N];
    static int[] lvl = new int[MAX_N];
    static int[] Q = new int[MAX_N];
    static int num_edges, num_nodes, source, sink, qf, qb;

    static void init_graph(int n, int s, int d) {
        num_nodes = n;
        source = s;
        sink = d;
        num_edges = 2;
        Arrays.fill(head, 0, n + 1, 0);
    }

    static void add_edge(int u, int v, int cap) {
        E[num_edges] = new Edge(v, 0, cap, head[u]);
        head[u] = num_edges++;
        E[num_edges] = new Edge(u, 0, 0, head[v]);
        head[v] = num_edges++;
    }

    static boolean bfs_level() {
        Arrays.fill(lvl, 0, num_nodes + 1, 0);
        qf = qb = 0;
        Q[qb++] = source;
        lvl[source] = 1;
        while (qf < qb && lvl[sink] == 0) {
            int u = Q[qf++];
            for (int e = head[u]; e != 0; e = E[e].next) {
                int v = E[e].v;
                if (lvl[v] == 0 && E[e].f < E[e].c) {
                    lvl[v] = lvl[u] + 1;
                    Q[qb++] = v;
                }
            }
        }
        return lvl[sink] != 0;
    }

    static int dfs(int u, int f) {
        if (u == sink) return f;
        for (int e = ptr[u]; e != 0; e = ptr[u] = E[e].next) {
            int v = E[e].v;
            if (lvl[u] < lvl[v] && E[e].f < E[e].c) {
                int df = dfs(v, Math.min(f, E[e].c - E[e].f));
                if (df > 0) {
                    E[e].f += df;
                    E[e ^ 1].f -= df;
                    return df;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int dinic() {
        int ret = 0, df;
        while (bfs_level()) {
            System.arraycopy(head, 0, ptr, 0, num_nodes + 1);
            while ((df = dfs(source, MAX_FLOW_VAL)) > 0) {
                ret += df;
            }
        }
        return ret;
    }

    static int R;
    static String[] B1 = new String[MAX_D];
    static String[] B2 = new String[MAX_D];

    static int[] DR = {0, 1, 0, -1};
    static int[] DC = {1, 0, -1, 0};

    static boolean valid(int i, int j) {
        return i >= 0 && j >= 0 && i < R && j < R && B1[i].charAt(j) != 'Y' && B1[i].charAt(j) != 'Z';
    }

    static int[][][] d = new int[2][MAX_D][MAX_D];

    static void bfs_dist(int si, int sj, int idx) {
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_D; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < MAX_D; j++) {
                d[idx][i][j] = 0;
            }
        }
        d[idx][si][sj] = 1;
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(new int[]{si, sj});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int i = cur[0], j = cur[1];
            if (idx == 1 && d[0][i][j] != 0 && d[0][i][j] <= d[1][i][j]) continue;
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                int ni = i + DR[k], nj = j + DC[k];
                if (valid(ni, nj) && d[idx][ni][nj] == 0) {
                    d[idx][ni][nj] = d[idx][i][j] + 1;
                    q.add(new int[]{ni, nj});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static int[][][] id = new int[2][MAX_D][MAX_D];

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        R = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int T = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        int zi = 0, zj = 0;
        int node_cnt = 0;

        for (int i = 0; i < R; ++i) {
            B1[i] = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < R; ++j) {
                if (B1[i].charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    zi = i;
                    zj = j;
                } else if (B1[i].charAt(j) != 'Y') {
                    node_cnt++;
                    id[0][i][j] = node_cnt;
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < R; ++i) {
            B2[i] = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < R; ++j) {
                if (B2[i].charAt(j) != 'Y' && B2[i].charAt(j) != 'Z') {
                    node_cnt++;
                    id[1][i][j] = node_cnt;
                }
            }
        }

        node_cnt++;
        int src = 0, dst = node_cnt;

        init_graph(node_cnt, src, dst);

        for (int i = 0; i < R; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < R; ++j) {
                if (B1[i].charAt(j) != 'Z' && B1[i].charAt(j) != 'Y') {
                    add_edge(src, id[0][i][j], B1[i].charAt(j) - '0');
                    add_edge(id[1][i][j], dst, B2[i].charAt(j) - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        bfs_dist(zi, zj, 0);

        for (int i = 0; i < R; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < R; ++j) {
                if (B1[i].charAt(j) > '0' && B1[i].charAt(j) <= '9') {
                    bfs_dist(i, j, 1);
                    for (int ii = 0; ii < R; ++ii) {
                        for (int jj = 0; jj < R; ++jj) {
                            if (B2[ii].charAt(j) > '0' && B2[ii].charAt(jj) <= '9') {
                                if (d[1][ii][jj] != 0 &&
                                    (d[0][ii][jj] == 0 || d[0][ii][jj] >= d[1][ii][jj]) &&
                                    d[1][ii][jj] - 1 <= T) {
                                    add_edge(id[0][i][j], id[1][ii][jj], MAX_FLOW_VAL);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(dinic());
    }
}
